The corresponding source-level check is specified by `repro_v10/custodian/e2_stage7/nesting_check_stage7.R` with its target list. Batch nesting cannot be verified from the exported aggregates alone. The Zenodo binA/B/C files are random storage splits, each containing all non-targeting cells, not experimental batches. Stage 7's controls are pseudo-controls drawn from perturbed cells and its truth comes from a different laboratory, so the KOLF failure mode, in which prediction and truth share one offset and the unweighted ranking is raised by it, cannot arise. A prediction-side-only offset changes the weighted ranking through `w_j delta_g`; if the batches correlate with the biological grouping of targets its direction cannot be fixed in advance, so aggregate outputs alone do not determine the effect of batch nesting.
